content: Gacha/capture RNG fairness: pity systems (soft pity = increasing probability; hard pity = guaranteed after N) are the industry standard fairness mechanism. Transparency is legally mandated in several jurisdictions (China first; requires prominent disclosure, correct figures matching actual algorithm, no pseudo-random systematic deviation, pity counter visibility, pity inheritance rules on banner updates). Common violations that destroy trust: buried disclosures, partial pool disclosure, published probabilities inconsistent with actual algorithm, undisclosed pity resets. Perceived fairness matters: disclose effective frequencies not just raw rates. Regulatory trend: disclosure + spending limits + clear warnings. For a capture mechanic, equivalent = pity/streak system on capture attempts and published per-rarity capture rates.
